answer_4.quote: We recruit 45 annotators via Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk); details on the qualification process are in Appendix A.2.1.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the three evaluation questions in Table 2 immediately following each reading comprehension question to assess question quality. Q1 is used to determine inclusion into the final dataset, as we exclude any questions for which the majority of annotators marked that the question was either ambiguous or unanswerable. Q2 and Q3 are used for feedback to the writers.
criteria: how much of the passage is needed
